notes: Shaded rendering of real LRO NAC DTM elevation (not a photo). Crop is a 2.4km square placed to minimize nodata while containing the DTM's highest well-supported pixel (>=60m from any stereo-correlation gap), resampled to 1024x1024. Spawn is the lowest-slope point within 300-1000m of the summit. mask.bin marks nodata-filled cells (rendered as a hatched no-data texture in albedo.jpg/preview.png); spawn and goal are kept >= 20px clear of them. spawn relocated from (65,628) to (214,633) -- original was within 20px of a nodata-filled cell; picked the lowest-slope real-data cell satisfying the clearance instead.
maskMeaning: 1 = no orbital data (filled), treat as impassable
